title: The Social life of the town
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：social　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 social 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the postman wrote of ① a social life of the town in the list, and everybody in the office said at once that it was ② so social that nobody in the office would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the postman, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the social ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the social life of the town that anybody there had ever seen, or so the list for June 1967 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too social to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the sender who had come to help; the social ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a social evening at the hall, and said that no sender in his right mind would call it ⑥ as social as the evening at the hall they had once had in the old office. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was social or not, and he said so.

By 1980 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was ⑦ something social, and nothing besides. The sender from the next office called the whole plan ⑧ quite social; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the list kept the names of the social ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1983, with great care, she wrote of another social life of the town in the same list, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less social than anybody had expected. ⑩ The social evening at the hall that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1985, was the one she could never quite name; the social ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 社会（前置定语 a social life of the town：1973 年邮差在收发清单里记下的那件社会的生活）
B. adj. 社会／社交（两处加强说法：so social that … 与 no less social than …）
C. adj. 社会／社交（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 社会（表语 too social to do：母亲觉得它太社会，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 社交（前置定语 a social evening at the hall：叔叔把整件事称作一桩社交的晚会）
F. adj. 社交（同级比较 as social as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩厅里的社交晚会相比）
G. adj. 社交（后置定语 something social：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 社交（受程度副词修饰 quite social：那位寄信人的评价）

items.q: a social life of the town
the social life of the town that
a social evening at the hall
The social evening at the hall that

answers.why: social 意为“社会”，1973 年邮差在收发清单里记下的是“一件社会的生活”，此处作前置定语 a social life of the town。
social 意为“社会”，此处用 so social that 结构，说它社会到邮局里没人敢靠近。
social 意为“社会”，收发清单上 六月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的社会镇上的社会生活，等于最高级的说法。
social 意为“社会”，母亲认为这件东西“太社会了，谁也用不上”，too social to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
social 意为“社交”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩社交的晚会”，此处作前置定语 a social evening at the hall。
social 意为“社交”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩厅里的社交晚会一样社交”，同级比较用 as social as。
social 意为“社交”，收发清单上那半行字要的是“社交的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something social。
social 意为“社交”，邻邮局来的那位寄信人认为这套计划“相当社交”，quite 修饰原级 social。
social 意为“社交”，no less social than 表示“其社交不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之社交不亚于任何人的预料。
social 意为“社交”，母亲 1985 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的社交晚会”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1973 年，邮差在收发清单里记下了一件社会的生活。（a social life of the town）
它社会到邮局里没有一个人敢靠近。（so social that …）
母亲觉得它太社会，谁也用不上。（too social to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩社交的晚会。（a social evening at the hall）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩厅里的社交晚会一样社交。（as social as …）
到了 1980 年，收发清单上只剩半行字：要的是一件社交的东西。（something social）
answers: In 1973 the postman wrote of a social life of the town in the list.
It was so social that nobody in the office would go near it.
My mother thought it too social to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a social evening at the hall.
He said nobody would call it as social as the evening at the hall they had once had.
By 1980 the list asked for nothing but something social.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 social 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1973 the postman wrote of a social life of the town in the list, and nobody forgot it.
It was the social life of the town that anybody there had ever seen, or so the list says.
My mother thought it too social to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a social evening at the hall, and nobody argued with him.
The sender from the next office called the plan quite social, and everybody laughed.
The social ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
